name: Wizard Tower
source:
Seiyuu Academy, international funding has equipped the school with the newest facilities and top of the line technology, marking it as an academy that breaks the mold. Many students from abroad study at the academy, to the point foreign exchange student is no longer used to describe their role at the school. You transfer to this incredible academy. You have to get a part-time job on campus in order to make enough money to get by while you live there. The list of possible jobs is outrageous and involves the students who control the academy!

[From [url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1119421899]iTunes[/url]]
translation:
Seiyuu学园凭借国际资金的支持，配备了最新的设施和尖端技术，成为一所打破常规的学园。这里有许多来自国外的学生，以至于“交换生”这个称呼已不足以描述他们在学园中的地位。你转学来到这所非凡的学园，却必须在校内找一份兼职，才能赚够在这里生活所需的费用。然而，可供选择的工作一个比一个离谱，而且还牵涉到那些掌控学园的学生！

（来源：[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1119421899]iTunes[/url]）
